jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Actual transparent PNG game WALK ANIMATION atlas, not a scene or concept mockup. Reference is only character identity, palette, proportions, materials, camera and pixel-style reference. REPLACE its poor locomotion with a professionally planned EIGHT-FRAME looping walk cycle. Exactly 8 columns × 4 rows, 32 complete sprites of ONE character. Landscape 2048x1024, even cells, consistent size and ground plane with ample 20px transparent gutters. No labels, text, floor, shadows, effects or grid. Genuine alpha. Maifeld-Detailpixel: warm detailed comic pixel clusters, dark muted outlines, upper-left light. Preserve exact clothing, hair, head and weapon silhouette across ALL frames.
Rows are four camera directions: row1 front three-quarter southeast (facing RIGHT); row2 front three-quarter southwest (LEFT); row3 back three-quarter northeast (RIGHT, clearly visible back); row4 back three-quarter northwest (LEFT, clearly visible back). Never change facing within a row.
Every row is ONE FULL walking cycle across columns 1–8 in temporal order, two alternating footfalls:
1 LEFT FOOT CONTACT: left leg extended forward heel down, right leg extended back toe on ground.
2 LEFT DOWN: weight lands onto left bent knee, right heel lifts and trailing foot begins swing.
3 LEFT PASSING: left leg supports under body; right knee bent swings PAST support leg, right foot off floor.
4 LEFT UP: left heel pushes off, right knee/foot advances to next contact.
5 RIGHT FOOT CONTACT: RIGHT leg extended forward heel down, LEFT leg back toe on ground. This must be visibly the OPPOSITE leg configuration from column1, NOT a copy!
6 RIGHT DOWN: weight lands on right bent knee, left heel lifts.
7 RIGHT PASSING: RIGHT leg supports under body, LEFT knee bends and passes, left foot airborne. OPPOSITE configuration from column3.
8 RIGHT UP: right heel pushes off, left leg swings toward column1 contact, making a seamless loop.
Figure walks IN PLACE around one fixed root, no cell-to-cell body drift. Always at least one foot grounded. Only small natural vertical body movement. Calm head, gentle opposite arm swing; no huge torso deformation, no identity drift, no jumps, no marching, no attacks, no exaggerated long stride. Show every distinct intermediate silhouette, especially airborne passing feet. Do not repeat the same stride in columns1 and5. No motion blur. No interpolation or smearing. Rendering target native human height52px.

Small brown makeup brush stays firmly attached to the SAME hand through all8 phases. Teal spray bottle stays at hip; apron/bow lag the stride only slightly. No floating implement. Maintain relaxed carry pose, never attack.
